findings.evidence: design.md: 'that entry is released through `agent_board.py finish --id`'. worktree_cleanup.py `_cleanup_abandoned`: `with locked_json(machine_path("agent_board", root)) as data: ... items.remove(claim)`.
findings.summary: design.md says the claim is released through `agent_board.py finish --id`. The code instead edits the board JSON directly with `locked_json` and `items.remove(claim)`. This duplicates board mutation logic outside agent_board and diverges from the written design, so any side effects `finish` has would be skipped.

findings.evidence: publication_state.py: `gh pr list --state all --head <branch> --base <base_branch> --limit 100`. `_abandoned_refusal` relies only on `lookup.exact_open`/`stale_open`/`exact_closed`.
findings.summary: The spec says no open PR may exist 'for the branch'. The proof comes from `find_exact_head_pr`, which lists PRs filtered by `--base main` and `--limit 100`. An open PR for the same branch into another base is never seen. A truncated list beyond 100 entries is not flagged as unavailable. In either case the abandoned proof could be accepted while the branch still has live work.
